key_highlights: Iron ore crash confirmed, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX and ASX200 materials weight
Oil spike from Houthi Red Sea escalation lifts energy names but pressures Qantas.AX, airlines
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job-cut restructuring plan faces execution risk; financials under scrutiny
Australian housing market shows no spring bounce; auction volumes weak, prices under downward pressure
Immigration policy overhaul debate intensifies; Joyce dismisses 'tanked economy' fears but productivity concerns persist
Fed meeting in focus with 10-year US yield at 5%; global risk-off sentiment
Junior miners active: Critica (tin-tungsten), Forrestania (gold), Sarytogan (graphite), PLC Resources (gold) advance
Major private hospital operator in financial collapse; healthcare sector consolidation risk
AI doomsday warnings from Anthropic/Nvidia spook global tech; rotation into UK and defensive names
Australia nears energy inflection point; structural shift in power generation mix

sectors.trend: Iron ore crash confirmed; strategic metals (tin, tungsten, graphite) see pentagon-driven demand. Junior explorers active in WA/Tasmania.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure. Strategic metal producers (e.g., CRG.AX, SRY.AX) and gold juniors (FOR.AX, PLC.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 job cuts faces execution risk. Housing weakness pressures NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX loan books. 10-year yield at 5% compresses valuations.
sectors.implications: Financials under dual pressure: credit risk from housing downturn and margin compression from elevated yields. ANZ.AX grand plan unproven. Defensive stance warranted.

sectors.trend: Oil spike on Middle East/Houthi conflict; Australia nears energy inflection point. Fuel excise cut pressure on government.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil prices. Qantas.AX, airline sector pressured by fuel costs. Energy transition names gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Major private hospital operator in financial collapse and division. J&J faces biosimilar competition globally.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX relatively insulated but sector consolidation risk. Private hospital operators (e.g., IAG-linked, HIC.AX) face M&A/liquidation risk. Defensive healthcare still preferred.

sectors.trend: Caravan manufacturer shutdown, steelworks job cuts, no auction bounce. Housing prices falling; young homeowners accepting lower prices.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary under pressure. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation headwinds. Staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) offer relative safety.

sectors.trend: AI doomsday warnings from Anthropic; Nvidia/Broadcom tumble; Trump dismisses AI slowdown calls. Bitcoin ETFs lose $463M.
sectors.implications: Limited direct ASX tech exposure but global risk-off sentiment dampens sentiment. CSL.AX, SXG.AX (tech-adjacent) may see flow effects. AUD/USD pressured.

key_themes: Iron ore demand destruction from China pivot and global slowdown
Geopolitical oil risk (Houthi/Red Sea) driving energy volatility
Australian housing correction deepening; no spring bounce
Immigration policy overhaul as macro growth substitute for productivity
Global AI/tech rotation and risk-off sentiment
Strategic metals and critical minerals as defensive growth theme
Fed rate path uncertainty with 10-year yield at 5%

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weight; rotate into gold and strategic metals
Underweight REITs and construction; monitor NAB.AX/CBA.AX credit provisions
Hedge fuel exposure; overweight energy producers; monitor Qantas.AX
Maintain defensive allocation; avoid chasing global tech rallies

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Immigration policy disruption to labour supply
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor construction and services sectors; watch RBA commentary on migration
Shorten duration; favour dividend-paying value over growth

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight strategic metals and critical minerals
opportunities.rationale: Pentagon deals driving 43%+ moves; graphite, tin, tungsten supply constrained; WA/Tasmania exploration pipeline active

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy exposure on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Houthi escalation supports oil; Australia energy inflection provides structural tailwind; fuel excise cut debate adds policy support

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight consumer staples as defensive anchor
opportunities.rationale: Housing correction and job cuts pressure discretionary; staples provide income and resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and pure-play mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore crash confirmed; China demand pivot; margin compression for BHP/RIO/FMG
No auction bounce, falling prices, credit risk building in bank loan books

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and global equity beta
defensive_moves.rationale: 10-year yield at 5%, AI risk-off, oil shock create volatility; AUD under pressure

market_outlook.short_term: ASX200 likely to tread water to modestly lower. Oil spike supports energy but iron ore crash and global AI risk-off offset. Fed meeting and 10-year yield at 5% cap risk appetite. ANZ restructuring and hospital operator collapse add idiosyncratic risk. Expect 2-4% downside volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand shift, housing correction, and immigration-driven growth model fragility. Energy transition and critical minerals offer offsetting upside. RBA likely to ease if housing/credit deteriorates. 6-12 month path: choppy, sector-rotational, with materials and energy outperforming financials and REITs.
